name: Steep Price
text: After bidding, you may pay 30 gold to turn a chosen card in your hand into an ace or a two.

signature.effect: optional: pay 30 gold, card becomes an ace or a two

archetypes: Blind Bidder, Bonus Chaser, Gold Miner, Diamond Flood
decision: Whether this round is worth 30 gold, and which card to fix: a two becomes an ace to rescue a shaky contract, or an ace becomes a two to save a nil.
opponent: The new rank is shown to the table; opponents can read it and play around it.
aiNote: On a nil, turn your most dangerous card into a two; on a contract one trick short, turn your highest card in your longest side suit into an ace. Pay only with 80 gold or more.
rationale: A sure fix either way is worth most of a trick on a contract or a large share of a nil's survival, so it costs 30 gold, about half a round's base income, which Gold Miner and Diamond Flood have spare. It turns gold into one decisive card change after everyone has bid.
deviation: Redesigned from moving a chosen card to a random rank, which had no reliable upside.
